decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing green mana acceleration through creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to quickly ramp up to high mana counts. The main strategy is to generate as much green devotion as possible, leveraging cards like Old-Growth Troll, Polukranos Reborn, and Cavaliers of Thorns to take advantage of that devotion. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Cityscape Leveler and storm the festival to disrupt opponents. Additionally, it incorporates utility and toolbox options with cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator.

This deck focuses on casting spells quickly and efficiently to bring out Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. The deck includes a mix of cheap spells for removal and card draw, combined with powerful sorceries like Pieces of the Puzzle and Temporal Trespass to refill the hand and gain extra turns. The key strategy is to effectively use instants and sorceries to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability and maintain pressure on the opponent while keeping the graveyard filled with relevant spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing Neoform to quickly tutor for key creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Dragonlord Atarka. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also setting up for powerful combos with cards like Otherworldly Gaze and Strategic Planning. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional ramp and mana fixing. The goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary pieces for a game-winning combo while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, backed up by disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly close out games. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and efficient threats, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless assault that can quickly take control of the game.

The main concept of the deck is to rapidly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also building up devotion to green with cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Old-Growth Troll. This allows for explosive plays with cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Polukranos Reborn, while also having utility spells such as Oath of Nissa and Cityscape Leveler for added flexibility. The key strategy is to quickly establish a strong board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly ramp up green mana using creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, while also building up devotion to green with cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. With a focus on aggressive plays and powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of efficient beaters and powerful, game-ending plays like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator. The inclusion of cards like Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner help to ensure the deck can consistently hit its key threats and answers.

This deck focuses on aggressively sacrificing creatures to generate value and create incremental advantages. By utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to control the board while chipping away at the opponent's life total. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Claim the Firstborn help disrupt the opponent's game plan and further push the aggressive strategy. The deck also has a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's overall game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to establish board control and pressure through a mix of evasive Spirits and tempo plays. By utilizing cards like Rattlechains and Spell Queller to disrupt opponents' plans, coupled with efficient threats like Shacklegeist and Curious Obsession to apply pressure, the deck aims to maintain a proactive game plan while disrupting the opponent's strategy. With a focus on flying creatures and countermagic, the deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victories through a combination of tempo advantage and aggressive plays.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful creatures and enchantments like Enigmatic Incarnation and Leyline Binding. By utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Fires of Invention, the deck can establish board presence and disrupt opponent's strategies. The inclusion of unique creatures like Keruga, the Macrosage and Agent of Treachery adds versatility and unpredictability to the deck, allowing for strategic plays that can swing the game in your favor. Additionally, the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's overall game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. It uses cards like Raffine's Informant, Grisly Salvage, and Thoughtseize to set up the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Traverse the Ulvenwald helps to find key cards, while Witherbloom Command and Vessel of Nascency provide additional card selection. The deck also includes powerful threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to pressure the opponent. Liliana of the Veil and Takenuma, Abandoned Mire offer additional disruption, while the mana base allows for consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption and removal spells. It utilizes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bonecrusher Giant to pressure the opponent early on. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and keep the opponent on the back foot while disrupting their game plan.

Emphasizing on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing incremental damage, this Rakdos Aggro deck utilizes a combination of Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, Mayhem Devil, and Bloodtithe Harvester to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. With disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, as well as card advantage from Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Deadly Dispute, the deck aims to control the game while chipping away at the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds consistency and an additional threat to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice synergies and aggressive creatures to put pressure on the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Bloodtithe Harvester, you can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to deal damage and control the board. Claim the Firstborn and Thoughtseize help disrupt your opponent's strategy while Fatal Push provides removal. With the help of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, you can maintain consistency and mana efficiency throughout the game. This deck aims to quickly overwhelm your opponent and secure victory through efficient sacrifice tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain tempo and aggression by utilizing a combination of Spirits with abilities that disrupt the opponent's board state while also dealing damage quickly. Key cards include Mausoleum Wanderer for early pressure, Spell Queller for removal and disruption, and Curious Obsession for card draw and additional aggression. By utilizing counterspells and evasion abilities, the deck aims to control the battlefield and quickly overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. This deck prioritizes synergy and efficiency to maintain the upper hand in the match.

This UW Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game. It uses counterspells, removal, and card draw to keep the opponent's threats at bay while slowly developing its own win conditions. The deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and efficient threats like Dream Trawler to close out the game once control is established. The mana base is built around powerful lands like Lotus Field and Hallowed Fountain to ensure consistency and stability throughout the game.

The deck focuses on flooding the board with small, aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard to generate strong early game pressure, while Thalia's Lieutenant and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provide support and buffs to the team. Ossification is used as a removal spell, while cards like Brave the Elements and Anointed Peacekeeper help protect the board. Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional creature tokens and mana sources to keep the offensive pressure on the opponent.

The deck revolves around using Indomitable Creativity to cheat big creatures into play and overwhelm the opponent. It also utilizes various spells and creatures to control the board and protect its combo pieces. The deck aims to create explosive turns where it can drop powerful threats like Worldspine Wurm or Xenagos, God of Revels, putting immense pressure on the opponent and closing out the game quickly. The mix of removal, card draw, and combo pieces allows for adaptability and flexibility in different matchups.

This combo deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow you to create tokens, such as Torrential Gearhulk and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and then sacrificing them to cast powerful spells like Magma Opus and Indomitable Creativity. By combining these effects, you can overwhelm your opponent with a stream of powerful creatures and spells, while also utilizing control elements like Fiery Impulse and Volcanic Spite to disrupt their strategy. The deck also includes utility lands like Mutavault and Den of the Bugbear to provide additional versatility and options in your gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with powerful green creatures and generate a lot of mana through devotion to green enchantments like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. Utilizing mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to cast big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn quickly. With support from cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, the deck can overwhelm opponents with its aggressive playstyle and high devotion to green cards.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with green mana-producing creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to ramp up to big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn. The deck also utilizes cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to generate more value and card advantage. The main goal is to quickly build up a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures and the devotion mechanic to Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator to provide additional utility and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent by quickly ramping up mana with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, then using that mana to play powerful green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck is focused on devotion to green, maximizing the benefits from Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. Karn, the Great Creator adds utility while Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa help find key cards. Overall, this deck aims to apply strong pressure early on and maintain board presence through its aggressive devotion to green strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing the player to cast powerful spells and combo off. The deck includes cards that can untap Lotus Field, tutor for it, and find ways to benefit from the mana it produces. By assembling the right pieces, the player can generate an overwhelming advantage and win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes cards for card draw and recursion to ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through discard spells like Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, and planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil. The deck also aims to generate card advantage with spells like Sign in Blood and Invoke Despair, as well as protecting its own life total with lifelink creatures like Gifted Aetherborn. The deck also has a sacrifice theme with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Phyrexian Fleshgorger, while utilizing powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy by utilizing low-cost creatures and spells in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck is built around the synergy between creatures that benefit from being supported by a strong leader, such as Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and General Kudro of Drannith, as well as utilizing removal spells like Dire Tactics to clear the way for attacks. The mana base is designed to support a consistent flow of creatures while also enabling a variety of colors for spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive strategies with powerful Rakdos creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to control the board while also dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of high-impact creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds additional threats that can overwhelm opponents. Additionally, the deck features strong late-game options like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Liliana of the Veil to maintain pressure and close out games.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly and aggressively. With cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board while dealing damage efficiently. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds a threatening presence to the board. Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing the deck to maintain its tempo and push for victory.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of sacrificing creatures for value, dealing incremental damage with triggers like Mayhem Devil, and disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck utilizes Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven for a constant stream of sacrifice triggers, while also incorporating powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. By applying pressure early and generating value from sacrificing creatures, this deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a aggressive manner.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrificing mechanics to gain advantage and disrupt the opponent, with cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil. It also incorporates discard and removal spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Jegantha, the Wellspring provide additional value and threats. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining a resource advantage through sacrificing creatures and using graveyard recursion.

The main concept of this deck is to establish a fast and aggressive tempo using Azorius colored spirits to control the board and pressure opponents. By playing efficient and evasive creatures like Rattlechains, Spell Queller, and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans while dealing consistent damage. Cards like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare further help in controlling the battlefield, while cards like Curious Obsession provide card advantage. The deck also includes counterspells like Lofty Denial and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponent's plays. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining board presence and controlling the game tempo.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with evasive Spirit creatures and countering opponent's spells to control the tempo of the game. By playing efficient creatures like Spell Queller and Supreme Phantom, supported by powerful enchantments like Curious Obsession, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan. With a mix of aggressive creatures, disruptive spells, and versatile lands, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure quick victories through constant pressure and control.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Dovin's Veto, and Settle the Wreckage, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly gaining incremental advantage until it can take over the game. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful card advantage engine and can provide additional value by blinking permanents for extra value. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and options for disrupting the opponent's mana base.

This aggressive white weenie deck focuses on getting early creatures on the board and buffing them up with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small creatures and protect them with cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Brave the Elements. The deck also benefits from anthem effects like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to pump up the team. With a mix of creatures, protection spells, and land utility, this deck seeks to maintain pressure and outpace the opponent in tempo.
